rollbackChecks.name: PBIP path exists
rollbackChecks.detail: Rollback rehearsal requires an existing PBIP project path.

rollbackChecks.name: PBIP entry point
rollbackChecks.detail: A .pbip file should be present so Desktop can reopen the project after rollback.

rollbackChecks.name: Semantic model folder
rollbackChecks.detail: A SemanticModel folder is expected for model artifact rollback checks.

rollbackChecks.name: Report folder
rollbackChecks.detail: A Report folder improves visual/page rollback rehearsal coverage.

rollbackChecks.name: TMDL/model artifacts
rollbackChecks.detail: TMDL files make model rollback review explicit and source-reviewable.

rollbackChecks.name: Apply draft manifest
rollbackChecks.detail: No draft manifest found. Rehearsal can still inspect PBIP structure, but artifact-specific rollback is limited.

rollbackChecks.name: Backup hints
rollbackChecks.detail: Backup files are optional, but their presence improves restore confidence.

rehearsalPlan: Confirm working tree or source-control snapshot before any manual restore.
Review PBIP entry point, SemanticModel, Report, and TMDL artifacts without copying or deleting files.
Map each apply-draft manifest artifact to the file that would be removed or restored during rollback.
Open the PBIP in Power BI Desktop after rehearsal and refresh metadata.
Run semantic tests, RLS leakage drafts, and release gate checks before publish.
